exposure: Maternal pertussis antibody levels (PT IgG, FHA IgG, FHA IgA, PT IgA)
Cord blood pertussis antibody levels (PT IgG, FHA IgG)
outcome: Pertussis seroprevalence in maternal serum and cord blood
Levels of PT IgG, FHA IgG, FHA IgA, and PT IgA in mothers and newborns
cohort: The study included 88 parturient mother-neonate pairs consisting of term-healthy neonates and their mothers from a single urban hospital in Tehran, Iran.
finding: The study demonstrated a low level of immunity against B. pertussis in pregnant females and many newborns, suggesting an increased risk of pertussis in very young infants.
cross-section timing: Immediately after birth, during the years 2015 and 2016.
birth_weight: Neonates were term-healthy, and birth weight was measured but showed no correlation with antibody levels.
gest_age: Neonates were term-healthy, and gestational age was measured but showed no correlation with antibody levels.
